subheadings.rawText: Founding engineer with 4+ years building scalable, multi-tenant web applications end-to-end (database to UI) using \textbf{TypeScript}, \textbf{React/Next.js}, \textbf{Python/FastAPI}, and \textbf{PostgreSQL}. Shipped AI, real-time, and growth features across \textbf{88 tenants} and \textbf{38,000+ users} on \textbf{GCP}.

resumeItems: \textbf{Languages & Frameworks:} TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, React, Next.js, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Node.js
\textbf{Cloud & DevOps:} GCP (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub), AWS (EC2, ElastiCache), Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions.
\textbf{Tools:} PostgreSQL, Redis, PostHog, Prometheus, React Query, Tailwind CSS, Firebase.

subheadings.position: Founding Engineer | Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, React Query, GCP
resumeItems: Engineered a crash-resistant \textbf{medical AI scribe} with IndexedDB persistence and exponential backoff (96.7% reliability) used across \textbf{83K+ sessions}, saving clinicians \textbf{11,000+ hours}.
Rewrote our \textbf{online booking}, driving a \textbf{63% MoM increase} to \textbf{3,800 bookings/month}, serving \textbf{70K+ patients}.

Built an end-to-end \textbf{email platform} with a reusable WYSIWYG composer, webhook-driven delivery tracking, enabling \textbf{email marketing campaigns}, touching \textbf{12,600+ recipients} and sending \textbf{68K+ emails}.

Designed the \textbf{drag-and-drop scheduling builder} enabling \textbf{42+ clinics} to configure multi-service appointment, powering \textbf{157K+ staff-scheduled appointments} and \textbf{20K+ upsells}.
Built the company's first \textbf{analytics stack} ingesting \textbf{29.2M events} via PostHog with a \textbf{95-event taxonomy}.

Drove company-wide adoption of \textbf{React Query}, establishing patterns for cache invalidation, optimistic updates, and mutation handling resulting in instant page loads while eliminating stale data bugs via stale-while-revalidate caching.

subheadings.position: Founding Engineer | JavaScript, Go, ElastiCache, EC2
resumeItems: Developed a custom \textbf{Webpack }configuration to build a hybrid \textbf{JavaScript/React Chrome extension}.
Built high-performance AWS microservices with \textbf{Go}, \textbf{ElastiCache}, and \textbf{EC2} for an asynchronous learning platform.
Mentored 6 junior developers on \textbf{TypeScript} and \textbf{React} through code reviews and pair programming.
Introduced \textbf{Agile }and \textbf{Lean} best practices, improving feature delivery and system stability.

subheadings.position: Software Engineer | Go, Next.js, Kubernetes, GCP

Led a sprint as \textbf{SCRUM Lead} across 8+ teams, introducing rituals that cut incomplete Jira epics by 40%.
